info.name: Reddit - Hacker Green | Retro Phosphor Terminal
info.description: Give Reddit the look of a vintage hacker terminal. Hacker Green V4 transforms modern Reddit into a deep-black, neon-green phosphor interface with monospaced typography, glowing links, crisp post borders, dark panels, and terminal-inspired controls. The theme covers the main feed, post pages, comments, header, navigation, search, dialogs, and the Communities sidebar. Images and videos keep their original colors. The optional enhanced version uses Reddit theme tokens to carry the palette into compatible interface components.
